claims: No. 1 seed South Carolina defeated No. 16 seed Southern University 103-34 in the first round of the 2026 NCAA Women's Tournament on March 21, 2026.
Joyce Edwards scored 27 points for South Carolina.
South Carolina set a school record for the largest margin of victory in an NCAA Tournament game.
South Carolina held Southern University to 34 points.
South Carolina held Southern University to 18% shooting.
South Carolina opened with a 15-0 run.
South Carolina led 19-6 after the first quarter.
South Carolina outscored Southern University 32-2 in the third quarter.
South Carolina held Southern University to zero field goals in the third quarter.
Joyce Edwards had 8 rebounds for South Carolina.
Ta'Niya Latson scored 17 points for South Carolina.
Madina Okot scored 15 points for South Carolina.
Tessa Johnson scored 14 points for South Carolina.
Tessa Johnson had 10 rebounds for South Carolina.
Jocelyn Tate scored 10 points for Southern University.
South Carolina advances to play the winner of #8 Clemson vs. #9 Southern Cal.
